data.name: Muhawwin
data.gender_notes: Muhawwin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is intelligent, wise, thinks deeply and plans ahead. The name Muhawwin carries the meaning “Intelligent, wise, thinker, planner” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muhawwin usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise, thinker, planner and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who is deeply connected to his wisdom and intelligence, and uses it to serve and grow spiritually.
data.etymology: Muhawwin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, wise, thinker, planner.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhawwin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مُحَوِّن
in_arabic.meaning: اسم من مصادر التحويل، جعل الشيء يتغير
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُحَوِّن هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'حَوَّلَ' والذي يعني تغيير الشيء أو تحويله من حالة إلى أخرى. يرتبط هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم بالتغيير والتحويل، وغالبًا ما يستخدم في سياق التوبة والتحول نحو الأفضل. في التقاليد الإسلامية، يُعتبر اسم مُحَوِّن تعبيرًا عن القدرة الإلهية على تغيير الأحوال والمقادير.

in_urdu.name: مُحَوِّن
in_urdu.meaning: نام تبدیلی کرنے والا، ایک حالت سے دوسری حالت میں تبدیل کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُحَوِّن ایک نام ہے جو عربی فعل 'حَوَّلَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے تبدیل کرنا یا تبدیل ہونا۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، یہ نام اللہ کی قدرت کی علامت ہے جو حالات اور مقادیر کو تبدیل کر سکتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان تاریخی اور ثقافتی سیاق و سباق میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن کی آیات کے حوالے سے جو تبدیلی اور توبہ پر زور دیتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुहव्विन
in_hindi.meaning: परिवर्तन करने वाला, एक स्थिति से दूसरी स्थिति में बदलने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहव्विन एक नाम है जो अरबी क्रिया 'حَوَّلَ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बदलना या परिवर्तन करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है और इसे ईश्वर की शक्ति के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है जो परिस्थितियों और नियतियों को बदल सकता है। यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जो इस्लामी मूल्यों और परंपराओं में महत्वपूर्ण माने जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: مُحَوِّن
in_pashto.meaning: د بدلونکی، له يوه حالت څخه بل حالت ته د بدلولو
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُحَوِّن د يو نوم څخه مشتق شوی دی چې د 'حَوَّلَ' کلمې څخه راغلی دی، چې په معنی دی بدلول یا د بدلون سبب ګرځول. په افغان او پښتني دودونو کې، دا نوم د خدای د قدرت څرګندونه کوي چې حالات او مقادیر بدلولی شي. دا نوم په پښتو کلتور او اسلامي عقیدت کې ځانګړی اهمیت لري، په ځانګړي ډول د قرآن کریم په آیاتونو کې چې د بدلون او توبې په اړه دي.

in_english.name: Muhawwin
in_english.meaning: The one who changes or transforms
in_english.long_meaning: Muhawwin is derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-w-l' which signifies change or transformation. In Islamic tradition, this name reflects the divine attribute of altering circumstances and destinies. It is associated with the concept of repentance and turning towards a better path. Historically, the name has been used across Muslim cultures to signify the power and mercy of Allah. The spiritual significance of Muhawwin lies in its connotation of positive change and renewal.

Additionally, the name Muhawwin can be seen as a reflection of Allah's infinite knowledge and wisdom, and encourages individuals to strive towards emulating Allah's qualities in their own lives.

historical_references.context: The Battle of the Ditch (Ghazwa Al-Saffin) took place, and the Umayyad Caliph Suleiman ibn Abdul Malik sent an army under the command of Al-Muhawwis Al-Tamimi. The battle ended with a decisive victory for the Muslims.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abd al-Hadid's Sharh Nahj al-Balagha, Volume 2, Page 370 The name Muhawwin carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Muhawwis ibn Abi Sufyan, the commander of the right wing of the Muslim army during the Battle of Uhud, was known for his valor and bravery. He was responsible for defeating the enemy's right wing, enabling the Muslim army to secure a significant victory.

modern_usage.modern_context: Muhawwins, also known as Muawwis or Mu'awwis, were skilled calligraphers in the Islamic world, particularly during the Abbasid period (750-1258 CE). Their works have been celebrated for their elegance, beauty, and intricacy. Today, the term 'Muhawwin' is often used to refer to individuals or works that embody similar qualities in the fields of Islamic history, art, and calligraphy. On Instagram, one can find countless posts featuring stunning examples of Islamic calligraphy, many of which are reminiscent of the work of Muhawwins. On Pinterest, there are boards dedicated to Islamic art and calligraphy, where users can save and share images of beautiful Muhawwin-inspired works. On Reddit, communities such as r/islamicart and r/calligraphy offer a space for enthusiasts to discuss and learn about the history and techniques of Islamic calligraphy, often with a focus on the works of Muhawwins.
